subject.title: feat(android): resume chat from the afterSeq cursor after reconnect

question: After the session-id bug is fixed and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100267 lands, should Android adopt the `chat.history.afterSeq` reconnect cursor as part of the mobile reconnect workstream?
rationale: This PR adds new client behavior against an unmerged Gateway protocol surface and the linked reconnect issue is maintainer-labeled, so final acceptance depends on maintainer intent beyond the mechanical Android fix.

options.title: Accept after fixes
options.body: Fix the Android session-id regression, keep the legacy-gateway fallback, and land this after the Gateway cursor PR.

options.title: Pause for full mobile review
options.body: Hold Android adoption until Gateway, iOS, Android, and in-flight run semantics are reviewed as one reconnect design.

options.title: Reject cursor adoption
options.body: Keep full-history refresh as Android's supported reconnect path and leave cursor-based mobile recovery out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Accept after fixes
recommendation.body: Fix the Android session-id regression, keep the legacy-gateway fallback, and land this after the Gateway cursor PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the proposal and has the clearest history across the linked Android and Gateway reconnect workstream.
